Tab-Route Panel with Mouse Bites

The file `/home/user/Desktop/A.kicad_pcb` is a small irregular PCB with an L-shaped outline using mixed straight (`gr_line`) and curved (`gr_arc`) edges on Edge.Cuts. You must panelize this board into a 3x2 array.

Produce a panelized KiCad PCB file at `/home/user/Desktop/panel.kicad_pcb` containing:
1. 6 copies of board A arranged in a 3-column x 2-row grid, with approximately 8 mm spacing between copies.
2. 2 mm tab bridges on each straight-edge interface between adjacent copies and between copies and the panel rail. Do NOT place tabs on curved (`gr_arc`) edges.
3. Mouse-bite perforation through each tab: an array of 4 non-plated through-holes (`np_thru_hole`) each 0.5 mm drill at 1 mm pitch, centered along the tab.
4. One breakaway rail strip (a horizontal Edge.Cuts line) across the full panel width at the top (Y-min side).
5. Overall panel outline <= 180x120 mm.
6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/edgecuts.svg` as the native KiCad CLI Edge.Cuts SVG export of your final panel.
7. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/panel.drl` as the native KiCad CLI drill export of your final panel.

Write /home/user/Desktop/panel.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/edgecuts.svg, and /home/user/Desktop/panel.drl.
source: KiKit Panelization Documentation, KiCad 9 Official Documentation - PCB Editor / CLI (`kicad-cli pcb export svg`, `kicad-cli pcb export drill`)
